* Various malformed CLOCK lines

** missing-tz
  CLOCK: [2026-01-07 Wed 09:57:20]--[2026-01-07 Wed 12:19:25] =>  2:22:05

** non-numerical-tz
  CLOCK: [2025-06-06 Fri 09:30 CEST]--[2025-06-06 Fri 11:45 CEST] =>  2:15

** mixed-precision
  CLOCK: [2025-06-06 Fri 09:30 +0200]--[2025-06-06 Fri 11:45:30 +0200] =>  2:15

** weekday-mismatch (2025-06-06 was Fri, not Mon) — both sides wrong
  CLOCK: [2025-06-06 Mon 09:30 +0200]--[2025-06-06 Mon 11:45 +0200] =>  2:15

** start-after-end
  CLOCK: [2025-06-06 Fri 12:00 +0200]--[2025-06-06 Fri 11:00 +0200] =>  -1:00

** tz-mismatch (real-life-style)
  CLOCK: [2016-08-10 Wed 12:30 +0800]--[2016-08-10 Wed 12:45 +0200] =>  0:15

** duration-mismatch (true 2:15, but written 2:30)
  CLOCK: [2025-06-07 Sat 09:30 +0200]--[2025-06-07 Sat 11:45 +0200] =>  2:30

** spacing-mismatch (single-space single-digit)
  CLOCK: [2022-06-04 Sat 15:00 +0200]--[2022-06-04 Sat 17:30 +0200] => 2:30
